scenes.text: At the rear door of the cardiac gallery, picture a curved circumflex key. Keep that same doorway as your memory location whenever coronary dominance returns.
scenes.spokenText: At the rear door of the cardiac gallery, picture a curved circumflex key. Keep that same doorway as your memory location whenever coronary dominance returns.

scenes.text: Coronary dominance follows the artery that gives rise to the posterior descending artery. On the angiogram, trace that vessel back to its parent artery.
scenes.spokenText: Coronary dominance follows the artery that gives rise to the posterior descending artery. On the angiogram, trace that vessel back to its parent artery.

scenes.text: In a left-dominant circulation, the posterior descending artery comes from the circumflex. Its septal branches supply the posterior part of the interventricular septum.
scenes.spokenText: In a left-dominant circulation, the posterior descending artery comes from the circumflex. Its septal branches supply the posterior part of the interventricular septum.

scenes.text: The circumflex also supplies the lateral left ventricular wall through its branches. A clot at its origin can therefore threaten both territories downstream.

scenes.text: For the book's example, combine the lateral left ventricular wall with the posterior septum. Identifying only one of those regions would leave out part of the pattern.

scenes.text: Return to the rear door: the circumflex key opens the lateral room and the back septal room. The recall cue is simple: left dominance, circumflex supplies the back.
